name: Bounded feature
description: Deliver one well-scoped feature from acceptance behavior through implementation, checks, and a reviewable terminal receipt.

outcomes.description: The requested feature behavior is implemented with explicit success and failure handling.
The change has a named integration point, quality result, and safe rescue route.

prerequisites.description: The feature request names user-visible behavior, non-goals, and acceptance evidence.
prerequisites.check: Read the acceptance note and split it into observable cases.

prerequisites.description: The files and external resources needed by the feature can be reserved without overlap.
prerequisites.check: List relative scopes and check active reservations before editing.

lanes.objective: Turn the request into acceptance cases, non-goals, and independent scopes.
Implement the agreed feature behavior without unrelated cleanup.
Verify acceptance, failure handling, compatibility, and the declared non-goals.

qualityGates.description: Every acceptance case maps to an observable check and a named owner scope.
Focused and relevant broad checks pass with no ignored failures.
The diff is narrow, documented, and tied to a terminal integration target.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Enter a password, one-time code, passkey, or challenge response.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop and hand the entry to the owner; prepare context without typing or recording the secret.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Authentication material is a human-only boundary.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Change billing, account security, destructive data, or live financial behavior as part of the feature.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop before the action and obtain one explicit owner confirmation for that individual action.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Feature work is limited to reversible and verified behavior.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Keep the acceptance cases and return to the last known-good integration point if a gate fails.
rescueSteps: Capture redacted status, diff, and check results.
Preserve the feature patch in its reserved scope.
Record whether the feature was merged or abandoned.
stopConditions: The change needs an overlapping scope.
A protected owner boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Omit credentials, tokens, private paths, and personal data.
Keep only safe identifiers and summarized outcomes.
